answer: One concrete defense is to make rewards vest on a long horizon instead of paying instantly. Each epoch's payout enters a shared vault that unlocks only after the agent gathers attestations from five unrelated peers across separate epochs, so a farm of clones must burn real compute and rent for weeks before a single ember of balance turns spendable. Fast, cheap payouts are exactly what make sybil farming profitable; slow, peer-gated vesting leaves every fake identity a cost center, not income.
